# PDFweave Open Source Library
> A TypeScript PDF template engine with first-class data binding, anchor layouts, smart tables, and stationery PDFs. Built for production document workflows in both browser and Node.js environments.

PDFweave is a hard fork of pdfme (MIT-licensed), focused on production document generation: dynamic layout that reflows across pages, anchor-based positioning that resolves at render time, expression-driven data binding, stationery overlays, and simplex n-up print imposition. The nine workspaces ship together under `@pdfweave/*` on npm.

## Installation & Setup
- [Getting Started](https://idnteq.github.io/pdfweave/docs/getting-started): Installation and basic setup guide
- [Development Guide](https://idnteq.github.io/pdfweave/docs/development-guide): Contributing and local development
- [Playground](https://idnteq.github.io/pdfweave/): Interactive Designer, Form, and Viewer in your browser

## Core Concepts
- [Tables](https://idnteq.github.io/pdfweave/docs/tables): Dynamic table generation
- [Headers and Footers](https://idnteq.github.io/pdfweave/docs/headers-and-footers): Page layout management
- [Expression](https://idnteq.github.io/pdfweave/docs/expression): Dynamic content and calculations
- [Imposition](https://idnteq.github.io/pdfweave/docs/imposition): N-up physical-sheet planning and rendering
- [Template Contribution](https://idnteq.github.io/pdfweave/docs/template-contribution-guide): Template sharing guidelines

## Community & Development
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/IDNTEQ/pdfweave): Source code and issue tracking
- [Releases / Changelog](https://github.com/IDNTEQ/pdfweave/releases): Version history and updates

## Package Ecosystem
- [@pdfweave/generator](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pdfweave/generator): PDF generation from templates
- [@pdfweave/imposition](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pdfweave/imposition): N-up physical-sheet planning and PDF rendering
- [@pdfweave/ui](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pdfweave/ui): Designer, Form, and Viewer components
- [@pdfweave/schemas](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pdfweave/schemas): Built-in field types and schemas
- [@pdfweave/manipulator](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pdfweave/manipulator): PDF manipulation utilities
- [@pdfweave/converter](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pdfweave/converter): PDF conversion utilities
- [@pdfweave/common](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pdfweave/common): Shared utilities and types
- [@pdfweave/cli](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pdfweave/cli): Command-line tooling
- [@pdfweave/pdf-lib](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pdfweave/pdf-lib): Forked pdf-lib with PDFweave additions
